brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Two full-depth bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full on adjacent cells (0,0,0) and (1,0,0), connected and capped. Staged with spoon/fork props.

Configurator checks fit/collisions only. Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material; waterproofing depends on material, print settings and sealing and cannot be verified here. Shape provides open bins for utensils but no sealed waterproof guarantee.

Dishwasher safety depends on material choice (heat resistance, food safety) and print parameters, which the configurator does not check. Cannot be claimed met; user must select dishwasher-safe filament and validate.

finish.summary: Built a compact 2-cell utensil holder with two full-depth bins. Waterproof/dishwasher-safe are material-dependent and cannot be verified by the configurator, so marked unmet.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
